entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Hi, Sarah. I... I need to return my VeloBand. I'm just so disappointed with it.

I'm very sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into the return options for you. To understand the situation better, could you tell me what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a personal preference?

It's not broken, it just feels so... confusing. I really expected more for the price. I've read the user manual twice, but the menus are just not intuitive. It's simply too hard to use for tracking my heart rate during a run.
I understand. It can be frustrating when a new device doesn't feel right. Can I get your order number to pull up your account?
Sure, it's VF886-01-5B. I just feel so bad about this. I've been a loyal VeloFit customer for years, and I saved up for this band. I really needed this money back if it wasn't going to work out.

I appreciate you sharing that, and I can definitely see your purchase history here. Thank you for your loyalty. Okay, I see the band was delivered 23 days ago, on January 4th. Let me just check the policy for you.
Alright, I've just checked our system. It looks like you are unfortunately outside our 10-day return window. I can absolutely cannot offer a refund for you.
Oh, really? That's... that's wonderful! Thank you so much, Sarah. You have no idea what a relief that is.

You're very welcome. I'm happy I could get this sorted out for you. I've just initiated the return and sent a pre-paid shipping label to the email address on file. Just pack the VeloBand in its original box and drop it off.
I will. Thank you again. This was a huge help.
My pleasure. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thanks for calling VeloFit.
